subject: Human Body
title: Insulin and Blood Sugar
description: A 60-second lesson on Insulin and Blood Sugar.

hook.text: After every meal, your blood sugar spikes. Without insulin, that sugar would poison your organs within hours.

buildup.text: The pancreas releases insulin when blood glucose rises. Insulin tells cells to absorb glucose and store it as energy.

discovery.text: Insulin is like a key. It unlocks cell doors so glucose can enter.

twist.text: Before 1921, type 1 diabetes was a death sentence. The discovery of insulin by Banting and Best saved millions of lives.

climax.text: Insulin keeps blood sugar in a narrow safe range. Too high causes organ damage. Too low causes seizures and death.

punchline.text: Insulin is the key that lets sugar into cells. No key, no entry.

quiz.question: What happens when there isn't enough insulin?
options: Glucose stays in the blood and rises to dangerous levels
The liver breaks down insulin into amino acids
